'''Vixxon's Shear''' was the name of a rock outcropping in the southwestern corner of the [[Alien Gangland]], a region in the southern reaches of the [[High Security Section]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis|battle]] on Belsavis during the [[Galactic War]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] established the [[Imperial Domination Outpost]] atop the Shear.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vixxon's Shear first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', but was only named in the list of medcenter names; if an Imperial player dies in the vicinity of the Domination Outpost, the Respawn at Medcenter option will identify the outcropping.<ref name="TOR" />
